name: icdrrmo
description: ICDRRRMO SMART Emergency Response — workspace scripts

scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:setup: docker compose up -d postgres redis && cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec api npx prisma db seed
scripts.firebase:seed: npm --prefix infra/firebase install && npm --prefix infra/firebase run seed
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm --prefix admin run export && npx -y firebase-tools@15.17.0 deploy --only hosting --project icdrrmo-b204e --non-interactive
